appraisal_events.evidence: leurs voitures, leurs chevaux, leurs maisons, leurs heures de liberté seraient à moi et je sentais que c'était de grand coeur que ces jeunes gens mettaient leur luxe, leur jeunesse, leur vigueur au service de ma faiblesse.
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup's officer friends warmly and sincerely offer the narrator their possessions and time, staging him as genuinely welcomed and included in their circle.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator is included, with evident sincerity, in the generous hospitality of Saint-Loup's aristocratic officer friends.
